name: CompositionRoot
summary: Assembles the application's object graph in one location as close as possible to its entry point, so that everything else is composed rather than composing.

reference.author: Steven van Deursen, Mark Seemann
reference.work: Dependency Injection Principles, Practices, and Patterns

roles.name: CompositionRoot
roles.summary: The one place where the application's modules are put together, and the only place a DI container may be referenced — every other module holds no reference to it. An application has one of these however large it grows; a library has none, because composing is the application's decision and not its dependencies'.
